title: Hospital Real Estate, Contractor Lawsuit
summary:
*   **Brackenridge Hospital Real Estate:** Officials engaged in private discussions regarding potential real estate transactions involving Brackenridge Hospital.
*   **Contractor Diversity Lawsuit:** The council received legal advice on a federal appeals court lawsuit filed by Austin Black Contractors Assoc., Inc.
*   **Flood Control & Drainage Land:** Discussions were held on acquiring private land for both the Creek Bend Flood Control Project and the Tannehill Drainage Project.
*   **City Code & Litigation:** Other private discussions included legal advice on possible city code amendments and another pending litigation case.
